propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (Jira field names/keys) while the inbound differ compares in canonical local shape, creating asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) seam principle

The outbound update path imports and uses vendor-specific helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) that force vendor snapshot knowledge into core, blocking epic bbf1 AC3

The outbound differ must canonicalize snapshot entries via injected InboundMapper before comparing, mirror the inbound differ's flow, and emit vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote at the boundary

The InboundMapper output must be widened with canonical alias keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that map vendor shapes to neutral identity/reference forms for canonical comparison

The baseline (stored in vendor shape) must be canonicalized at read time via InboundMapper, tolerating partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets by emitting only keys whose vendor source is present, preserving per-field local-wins arbitration

The assignee resolver must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving the three-state contract (payload_value, authoritative, is_account_id) for the _assignee_is_account_id sentinel downstream
